entities.name: EMM common procedures
entities.description: EMM procedures that can always be initiated while a NAS signalling connection exists. Initiated by the network.

entities.name: security mode control
entities.description: An EMM common procedure initiated by the network for security control.

entities.name: EMM specific procedures
entities.description: UE-initiated EMM procedures where only one can be running at any time. Includes attach, detach, tracking area updating, and eCall inactivity procedures.

entities.name: attach and combined attach
entities.description: UE-initiated EMM specific procedure to attach IMSI for EPS/non-EPS services, establish EMM context and default bearer.

entities.name: detach and combined detach
entities.description: UE or network initiated EMM specific procedure to detach IMSI and release EMM context and bearers.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated EMM specific procedure to detach IMSI for EPS/non-EPS services and release EMM context and bearers.

entities.name: tracking area updating
entities.description: UE-initiated EMM specific procedure (normal, combined, periodic) used when EMM context is established. Can request resource reservation for data.

entities.name: EMM connection management procedures
entities.description: S1 mode only procedures initiated by UE or network for connection establishment, resource reservation, or NAS message transport.

entities.name: service request procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated EMM connection management procedure to establish secure connection or request resource reservation for data.

entities.name: transport of NAS messages
entities.description: UE or network initiated EMM connection management procedure for transporting NAS messages.

entities.name: no UE initiated EMM specific procedure ongoing
entities.description: Condition that must be satisfied for service request procedure initiation.

entities.name: no EMM specific procedure or service request procedure ongoing
entities.description: Condition that must be satisfied for transport of NAS messages procedure initiation.

relations.description: Security mode control is a type of EMM common procedure.
Attach procedure is a type of EMM specific procedure.
Detach procedure is a type of EMM specific procedure.
eCall inactivity procedure is a type of EMM specific procedure.
Tracking area updating is a type of EMM specific procedure.
Service request is a type of EMM connection management procedure.
Transport of NAS messages is a type of EMM connection management procedure.
Service request procedure requires that no UE initiated EMM specific procedure is ongoing.
Transport of NAS messages procedure requires that no EMM specific procedure or service request procedure is ongoing.
